lines: I care for you.
Sova addresses the neighbor beside the garden path.
I am paying attention to Sova.
The neighbor takes the time they need to listen.
Sova cares for the neighbor.
The second caretaker names the same care from outside the duet.
I am registering acoustic input from you.
Sova hears the neighbor’s answering tone on their return.
I am registering acoustic input from Sova.
The neighbor hears the repeated phrase. The line describes reception.
I am paying attention to the pause.
The fellow caretaker listens through the space left for the answer.
I am paying attention to the traveler.
Neral makes time for the traveler at the bench.
I arrived at the bench.
The arriving traveler names the place they have reached.
I am able to move.
The waiting traveler considers their mobility while still at the bench.
I am registering acoustic input from you.
Neral takes in a traveler’s answering phrase.
I am paying attention to Neral.
The arriving traveler follows the route interpreter’s pulse.
It is possible that I am moving away from the bench.
The waiting traveler gives a possible departure a voice. Whether they leave stays open.
I am able to pay attention.
Pelli takes up the listening exercise again.
I am registering acoustic input from Pelli.
The first classmate hears Pelli’s line.
I am paying attention to Pelli.
The second classmate follows the learner’s part.
I am paying attention to the question.
Pelli names the subject of their shared attention.
I am paying attention to the silence.
The first classmate waits when Pelli stops.
I am able to pay attention.
The second classmate’s answer returns to the capacity heard in Pelli’s opening.
I am outside the room.
Keshet waits where the visitor asked.
The hand is restored.
The visitor sings about the repaired hand while becoming accustomed to it.
I care for the visitor.
Sova joins the later rendition with a care phrase.
I am paying attention to the visitor.
Keshet checks whether the quiet line should continue.
I am registering acoustic input from Keshet.
The visitor hears the sound they requested to mark time.
I am able to pay attention.
Sova leaves room for the visitor’s answer.
